model_organism.citation: Improved neuron protection following cortical injury in the absence of Semaphorin4B (PMID: 36531136)
phenotypes: Reduced neuronal cell death after cortical injury
More surviving neurons near the injury site
Wild-type neurons survive better on glial cultures from Sema4B knockout mice than on heterozygous cultures
Conditioned medium from Sema4B knockout glia increases neuronal survival, indicating a glia-dependent secreted factor

model_organism.citation: Astrocyte-to-microglia communication via Sema4B-Plexin-B2 modulates injury-induced reactivity of microglia (PMID: 38781210)
model_organism.knockout_type: full knockout (Sema4B-/-), heterozygous (Sema4B/Plexin-B2 double heterozygous), and microglia/macrophage-specific conditional Plexin-B2 knockout
phenotypes: Attenuated cytokine expression after cortical stab wound injury in Sema4B-/- mice
Sema4B-/- astrocytes attenuate injury-induced microglia reactivity compared with Sema4B+/- astrocytes
Microglia-specific Plexin-B2-/- mice show reduced microglial/macrophage reactivity and neuronal cell death after injury, similar to Sema4B-/- mice
Sema4B/Plexin-B2 double heterozygous mice show reduced microglial/macrophage reactivity after injury

model_organism.citation: Nakagawa et al. 2011 - Identification of semaphorin 4B as a negative regulator of basophil-mediated immune responses (PMID: 21270411)
phenotypes: Normal lymphocyte and dendritic cell functions
Enhanced basophil-mediated memory IgE production, abolished by anti-FcεRIα antibody treatment
Loss of T cell-derived Sema4B removes suppression of basophil-mediated Th2 skewing

model_organism.citation: Enhanced Protein Synthesis and Hippocampus-Dependent Memory via Inhibition of YTHDF2-Mediated m(6)A mRNA Degradation (PMID: 40959883)
model_organism.knockout_type: knockdown of Sema4B in hippocampus (in forebrain-specific YTHDF2 conditional knockout mice)
phenotypes: Reducing the YTHDF2 target Sema4B in the hippocampus reversed the enhanced hippocampus-dependent memory seen in YTHDF2 conditional knockout mice
YTHDF2 loss produced enhanced synaptic transmission, improved learning and memory, and increased activity-dependent protein synthesis

biological.citation: Sema4B-Plexin-B2 - Astrocyte-to-microglia communication via Sema4B-Plexin-B2 modulates injury-induced reactivity of microglia (PMID: 38781210)
biological.summary: Astrocytic Sema4B acts as a ligand for Plexin-B2 on microglia/macrophages and enhances their reactivity after cortical injury. Sema4B-/-, microglia-specific Plexin-B2-/- and Sema4B/Plexin-B2 double-heterozygous mice all show attenuated reactivity, placing both genes in the same signaling pathway.

biological.citation: Improved neuron protection following cortical injury in the absence of Semaphorin4B (PMID: 36531136)
biological.summary: Sema4B is mostly expressed by astrocytes in cortex. Sema4B knockout mice show reduced neuronal death after cortical injury. Wild-type neurons survive better on Sema4B-null glia or in their conditioned medium, indicating a glia-dependent, secreted-factor mechanism. Sema4B protein applied directly to neurons has no effect.

biological.citation: Astrogliosis Induced by Brain Injury Is Regulated by Sema4B Phosphorylation (PMID: 26464987)
biological.summary: Sema4B-deficient mice and cultured Sema4B-/- astrocytes show reduced astrocyte proliferation and altered activation after injury. The Sema4B ectodomain acts as an antagonist rather than a rescuing ligand. Its effects depend on phosphorylation of the intracellular domain at Ser825, so Sema4B functions as an astrocyte receptor.

biological.citation: Enhanced Protein Synthesis and Hippocampus-Dependent Memory via Inhibition of YTHDF2-Mediated m(6)A mRNA Degradation (PMID: 40959883)
biological.summary: SEMA4B is a downstream target of YTHDF2-mediated m6A mRNA decay in hippocampal neurons. Forebrain YTHDF2 loss stabilizes m6A mRNAs and enhances memory. Reducing SEMA4B in the hippocampus reverses the enhanced memory in the conditional knockout mice.

biological.citation: Identification of semaphorin 4B as a negative regulator of basophil-mediated immune responses (PMID: 21270411)
biological.summary: Sema4B is expressed in T and B cells. Sema4B-/- mice have elevated serum IgE and enhanced basophil-mediated memory IgE production. Recombinant Sema4B inhibits basophil IL-4 and IL-6 production, and T cell-derived Sema4B at T cell-basophil contact sites suppresses Th2 skewing.

biological.citation: Semaphorin 4B is an ADAM17-cleaved adipokine that inhibits adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis (PMID: 37121509)
biological.summary: Proteomics identified SEMA4B as an ADAM17-shed adipokine whose expression is regulated by thermogenic cues. Cleaved SEMA4B acts in an autocrine manner in brown adipocytes to repress adipogenesis, thermogenesis and lipid catabolism genes.

biological.citation: Semaphorin4B is elevated in rheumatoid arthritis and enhances the inflammatory phenotype of macrophages and fibroblast-like synoviocytes (PMID: 40598553)
biological.summary: Sema4B is higher in RA synovial tissue and RA FLS than in OA FLS, and inflammatory stimuli induce its expression. Sema4B promotes FLS migration and invasion, and enhances TNF-α/LPS-induced IL-6, IL-8, TNF-α, CCL-2, MMP-1 and MMP-3 production. In FLS this effect is mediated by PlexinB2, as shown by siRNA knockdown.

biological.citation: CLCP1 interacts with semaphorin 4B and regulates motility of lung cancer cells (PMID: 17213806)
biological.summary: A phage display screen and immunoprecipitation showed that SEMA4B (Sema domain) physically interacts with CLCP1. SEMA4B enhances ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of CLCP1, which regulates lung cancer cell motility.

biological.citation: SEMA4B inhibits growth of non-small cell lung cancer in vitro and in vivo (PMID: 25746385)
biological.summary: SEMA4B overexpression decreased NSCLC (A549, Calu-3) growth in vitro and in xenografts, while inhibition increased growth. SEMA4B suppresses PI3K/Akt signaling, causing FoxO1 nuclear retention and p21 induction, which changes proliferation but not apoptosis.

biological.citation: Hypoxia and hypoxia-inducible factor 1 repress SEMA4B expression to promote non-small cell lung cancer invasion (PMID: 24474252)
biological.summary: Hypoxia downregulates SEMA4B in NSCLC lines. SEMA4B is a direct HIF-1 target: HIF-1α binds a hypoxia-responsive element in the SEMA4B gene (luciferase reporter) and represses it. Ectopic SEMA4B abolishes hypoxia-induced invasion.
